name: jo9_chaotic
body:
! JO9 MOD START CHAOTIC_ESSENCE_HELPER | 2026-10-24_chaotic_essence
! count: eligible negative axes. apply: remove one held axis and consume one chaotic_essence on success.
! use: invoke apply and show the result. Actor roles are limited to the active slave or assistant.
result = 0
local $jo9_chaotic_mode = $args[0]
local $jo9_chaotic_role = $args[1]
if $jo9_chaotic_mode = 'apply': $jo9_chaotic_removed = ''
if $jo9_chaotic_mode ! 'count' and $jo9_chaotic_mode ! 'apply' and $jo9_chaotic_mode ! 'use': exit
if $jo9_chaotic_role ! 'slave' and $jo9_chaotic_role ! 'assistant': exit
local jo9_chaotic_state = dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_chaotic_role + '_state')
if jo9_chaotic_state <= CONST_INT['no_slave']:
 if $jo9_chaotic_mode = 'use': msg '사용할 대상이 없습니다.'
 exit
end
if $jo9_chaotic_mode = 'use':
 if chaotic_essence < 1:
  msg '카오틱 에센스가 없습니다.'
  exit
 end
 local jo9_chaotic_used = func('jo9_chaotic', 'apply', $jo9_chaotic_role)
 if jo9_chaotic_used = 1:
  msg '카오틱 에센스를 사용해 <<$jo9_chaotic_removed>> 특성을 제거했습니다. 남은 수량: <<chaotic_essence>>개.'
 else
  msg '제거할 부정 특성이 없습니다. 카오틱 에센스는 소모되지 않았습니다.'
 end
 result = jo9_chaotic_used
 exit
end
if $jo9_chaotic_mode = 'apply' and chaotic_essence < 1: exit
local jo9_chaotic_count = 0
local $jo9_chaotic_keys = ''
local $jo9_chaotic_labels = ''
local $jo9_chaotic_xps = ''
dynamic $replace({
 if jo9ceactor['grace'] < 0:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'grace'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '촌뜨기'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['dexterity'] < 0:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'dexterity'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '투박한 손놀림'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['sport_affinity'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'sport_affinity'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '게으름'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['masochism'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'masochism'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '통증 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'masochism_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['exhibitionism'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'exhibitionism'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '노출 기피'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'exhibitionism_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['meekness'] < 0:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'meekness'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '자유로운 영혼'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['selfesteem'] < 0:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'selfesteem'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '자책망상'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['abuse_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'abuse_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '연극성 인격장애'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'abuse_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['darkness_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'darkness_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '암흑 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'darkness_xp'

 end
 if jo9ceactor['blood_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'blood_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '혈액 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'blood_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['fire_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'fire_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '발화 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'fire_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['water_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'water_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '물 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'water_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['vermin_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'vermin_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '벌레 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'vermin_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['deprivation_attitude'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'deprivation_attitude'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '폐소 공포증'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'deprivation_xp'
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_gag_reflex'] = 1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_gag_reflex'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '반사적 구역질'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['anal_affinity'] < 0:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'anal_affinity'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '애널섹스 혐오'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['defiant'] = 1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'defiant'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '거센 반항심'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_voice_trait'] = 1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_voice_trait'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '선천적 벙어리'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_work_ethic'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_work_ethic'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '안분지족'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_focus'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_focus'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '산만함'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_grudge'] = 1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_grudge'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '옹졸함'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_constitution'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_constitution'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '약골'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
 if jo9ceactor['jo9_learning_trait'] = -1:
  $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_count] = 'jo9_learning_trait'
  $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_count] = '백치'
  $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_count] = ''
  jo9_chaotic_count += 1
 end
}, 'jo9ceactor', $jo9_chaotic_role)
if $jo9_chaotic_mode = 'count': result = jo9_chaotic_count & exit
if jo9_chaotic_count < 1: exit
local jo9_chaotic_pick = rand(0, jo9_chaotic_count - 1)
local $jo9_chaotic_selected = $jo9_chaotic_keys[jo9_chaotic_pick]
local $jo9_chaotic_selected_xp = $jo9_chaotic_xps[jo9_chaotic_pick]
dynamic $replace({
 jo9ceactor[$args[0]] = 0
 if $args[1] ! '': jo9ceactor[$args[1]] = 0
 if instr('|grace|dexterity|sport_affinity|masochism|exhibitionism|meekness|selfesteem|abuse_attitude|darkness_attitude|blood_attitude|fire_attitude|water_attitude|vermin_attitude|deprivation_attitude|', '|' + $args[0] + '|') > 0: jo9ceactor[$args[0] + '_revealed'] = 0
 if $args[0] = 'jo9_work_ethic' or $args[0] = 'jo9_focus' or $args[0] = 'jo9_grudge': jo9ceactor[$args[0] + '_known'] = 0
 if $args[0] = 'jo9_focus':
  jo9ceactor['jo9_focus_active'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_focus_xp_credit'] = 0
  $jo9ceactor['jo9_focus_subject'] = ''
 end
 if $args[0] = 'jo9_grudge':
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_pain'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_abuse'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_disgust'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_no_praise'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_shame'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_prisoner'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_job'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_forced'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_raped'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_defloration'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_artifact'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_cheap_gift'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_cheap_reward'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_pony_died'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_catfight'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_love_lost2'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_demote'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_friend_prisoned'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_friend_punished'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_sa_love_lost1'] = 0
  jo9ceactor['jo9_memory_neg_another_sleep_together'] = 0
 end
}, 'jo9ceactor', $jo9_chaotic_role), $jo9_chaotic_selected, $jo9_chaotic_selected_xp
$jo9_chaotic_removed = $jo9_chaotic_labels[jo9_chaotic_pick]
chaotic_essence -= 1
if $get_lab_space ! '': dynamic $get_lab_space
result = 1
! JO9 MOD END CHAOTIC_ESSENCE_HELPER
